title: Renters Insurance Underwriting Portal & API
summary: A FastAPI-based machine learning backend that simulates renters insurance policy data and trains a RandomForestRegressor for underwriting pricing, paired with a Streamlit frontend. The dependency string 'sdv' appears only as a coincidental substring in an unrelated conda package path, with no actual SDV usage.
